football_games.ddl: CREATE TABLE "football_games" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NULL, "intensity" INTEGER NULL CHECK("intensity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "fatigue_after" INTEGER NULL CHECK("fatigue_after" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "knock" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("knock" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "weight_before_kg" REAL NULL, "weight_after_kg" REAL NULL, "fluid_ml" INTEGER NULL, "imported" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("imported" IN (0, 1)))

goal_versions.ddl: CREATE TABLE goal_versions (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,metric TEXT NOT NULL,value REAL NULL,effective_from TEXT NULL,accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NULL,policy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

ladder_events.ddl: CREATE TABLE "ladder_events" ("event_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "ladder" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_key", "ladder"))

ladder_states.ddl: CREATE TABLE "ladder_states" ("ladder" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, "since" TEXT NOT NULL, "lumbar_on" TEXT NULL, "sessions_after" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("ladder"))

meal_items.ddl: CREATE TABLE "meal_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fat" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "source_verified" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("source_verified" IN (0, 1)))

meal_template_items.ddl: CREATE TABLE "meal_template_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "template_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

meal_templates.ddl: CREATE TABLE "meal_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "slot" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

meals.ddl: CREATE TABLE "meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time" TEXT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL)

measurements.ddl: CREATE TABLE "measurements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "fasted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("fasted" IN (0, 1)), "site" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "time" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("date", "site"))

morning_checks.ddl: CREATE TABLE "morning_checks" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "resting_hr" INTEGER NULL CHECK("resting_hr" BETWEEN 25 AND 220), feeling INTEGER NULL CHECK(feeling BETWEEN 1 AND 3), PRIMARY KEY ("date"))

plan_days.ddl: CREATE TABLE "plan_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_version_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_rounds" INTEGER NULL, "rest_between_rounds_sec" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("plan_version_id", "weekday"))

plan_exercises.ddl: CREATE TABLE "plan_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "sets" INTEGER NULL, "reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL, "rest_sec_max" INTEGER NULL, "grip" TEXT NULL, "block" TEXT NULL, "variant" TEXT NULL, "hold_sec_min" INTEGER NULL, "hold_sec_max" INTEGER NULL, "per_side" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("per_side" IN (0, 1)), "rir_min" INTEGER NULL, "rir_max" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "superset_group" TEXT NULL)

plan_versions.ddl: CREATE TABLE "plan_versions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "scheme" TEXT NULL)

profiles.ddl: CREATE TABLE "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "protein_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 130, "protein_max" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 160, "kcal_target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2400, "kcal_floor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, "min_warmup_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 360, "measure_interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 21, "measure_interval_max_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 28, "next_measurement_date" TEXT NULL, "cooldown_target_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 180, "never_to_failure" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("never_to_failure" IN (0, 1)), "length_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cm', "steps_target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7500, "kcal_target_football" INTEGER NULL, profile_origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacyUnknown', setup_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ready', setup_confirmed_at TEXT NULL, handoff_consent_at TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

progress_photos.ddl: CREATE TABLE "progress_photos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "angle" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "fasted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("fasted" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL)

reminders.ddl: CREATE TABLE "reminders" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "hour" INTEGER NULL, "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "threshold" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"))

session_rounds.ddl: CREATE TABLE "session_rounds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "round_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "work_sec" INTEGER NULL, "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL)

session_sets.ddl: CREATE TABLE "session_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "split" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("split" IN (0, 1)), "split_detail" TEXT NULL, "to_failure" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("to_failure" IN (0, 1)), "load_kg" REAL NULL, "variant" TEXT NULL, "rir" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rir" BETWEEN 0 AND 5))

sessions.ddl: CREATE TABLE "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_day_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plan_days (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "total_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "warmup_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cooldown_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rest_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rounds_done" INTEGER NULL, "rounds_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rounds_estimated" IN (0, 1)), "rpe" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rpe" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "limiting_exercise_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "context" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "out_of_plan" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("out_of_plan" IN (0, 1)), "incomplete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("incomplete" IN (0, 1)), "planned_rounds" INTEGER NULL, "technique_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("technique_ok" IN (0, 1)), "full_range" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("full_range" IN (0, 1)), "recovery_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("recovery_ok" IN (0, 1)), "pending_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_review" IN (0, 1)), "mode" TEXT NULL, "extra_reps" INTEGER NULL, "imported" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("imported" IN (0, 1)), "core_epochs" TEXT NULL)

skill_achievements.ddl: CREATE TABLE "skill_achievements" ("skill" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("skill"))

sleep_logs.ddl: CREATE TABLE "sleep_logs" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "hours" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("hours" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 16.0), PRIMARY KEY ("date"))

soreness_logs.ddl: CREATE TABLE "soreness_logs" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("level" BETWEEN 0 AND 10), PRIMARY KEY ("date", "zone"))

week_notes.ddl: CREATE TABLE "week_notes" ("week_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("week_index"))
